registrationForm.title: Registration
registrationForm.requirementsQuestion: Do you meet the following minimum requirements for registration?
registrationForm.requirementsBullet1: 350 jumps or a recommendation from one of the coaches.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet2Sub1: Able to fly belly and back track within the assigned quadrant, safely, in a group of 6 people (be able to maintain the assigned side of the formation, without crossing the center of the formation).
registrationForm.requirementsBullet2Sub2: Able to exit the airplane belly and back track and approach the formation safely.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet2Sub3: Able to separate from the group safely while maintaining track flight.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet3Sub1: Able to fly static seat and head-down.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet3Sub2: Able to perform seat and head-down grips.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet3Sub3: Able to perform a seat to head-down change while maintaining your slot.
registrationForm.requirementsBullet4: Able to fly static head down and head up. Able to fly on your feet and on your head and perform the change in your slot. Able to perform a grip on your feet and on your head.
registrationForm.biggestFormationHeadFirst: What is the biggest formation you have flown head first?
registrationForm.biggestFormationFeetFirst: What is the biggest formation you have flown feet first?
registrationForm.successMessage: Thank you! Your registration has been received.
registrationForm.errorMessage: Something went wrong while submitting. Please try again.
